.. change::
    :tags: feature, engine
    :tickets: 13800

    Added :meth:`_engine.CursorResult.next_result_set`, which advances a
    :class:`_engine.CursorResult` to the next result set exposed by a
    DBAPI cursor's :pep:`249` ``nextset()`` method.  The result is reused in
    place and rebuilt with the new result set's column metadata and result
    processors, so each set is read according to its own column definitions
    and references to the previous set's metadata can no longer read rows
    from the new set.  The method returns ``False`` and releases the
    underlying DBAPI cursor when no further result set is available, and
    driver errors raised while switching are propagated through the usual
    DBAPI exception handling while still ensuring the cursor is closed
    exactly once.
